assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one opaque full-bleed square watercolor background for a small Traveler Passport achievement card in the Polish camping app RazemGo. Artwork only.
Style: warm hand-painted watercolor and gouache with visible fine paper grain, translucent layered washes, natural proportions, painterly foliage, sage and pine greens, soft blue mountains, muted turquoise, cream highlights and gentle amber light. Charming illustrated camping travel poster, matching the app's existing watercolor campsite art. No photography, flat vector art or glossy 3D.
Composition: one continuous square scene, strongest recognizable subject in the upper half, around x=25–80%, y=12–52%, with generous edge margins. This will be cropped for a narrow portrait card, with a small stamp icon over the top-left and live UI text covering the lower 45%. Paint the entire lower scene naturally but keep it quiet and low-detail. Do not bake in a gradient or white panel.
Constraints: no writing, lettering, words, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, icons, medals, decorative border, UI or transparency.
Scene: Two friendly adult travelers sitting face to face at a wooden campsite picnic table, chatting and laughing naturally, each holding an enamel mug. A pine clearing and a softly painted cream-and-teal caravan behind them, warm afternoon sunlight. Keep both faces readable in the upper central part; no phones.
